page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with one marginal note in the left margin beside "In corde terrae". Below the text, at the right, the catchword "3. Quare".

main_text.p: ne quoq; sepultus est. uni enim & eidem naturae in Christi persona hæc conueniunt. Christus autem pro nobis passus est in carne : 1.Pet.4..1. In carne igitur, cui soli passio & sepultura illa competit, sepultus quoq; est.

Obseruent hoc loco studiosi aureum Augustini dictum : Et idcirco Dei Filium secundum substantiam diuinitatis suæ invisibilem, incorporeum & immortalem & incircumscriptum, nos credere & confiteri oportet: iuxta humanitatem vero visibilem, corporeum, localem, atq; omnia membra humana veraciter habetem, credere oportet & confiteri. De essentia divinitatis.
main_text.head: 2. Ubi sepultus est?
main_text.p: Locus.In corde terræ, id est, in sepulcro, de quo Matth.27.60. Joseph Arimathiensis posuit (corpus Domini Jesu) in monumento suo nouo, quod excíderat in petra : & aduoluto saxo magno ad ostium monumenti, abijt.Luc.23.53. Joa.19.41.42.
Si quia in Christo personaliter unitæ sunt duæ naturæ, divina & humana, hæc ubiq; fuisset, nec crucifigi, nec sepeliri in certo loco potuisset eius caro.

page.notes: Printed "1.Pet.4..1." reads with a double dot before 1; copied as printed. Ioa. and Jesu/Joseph use J as the consonant per the i/j rule. Catchword "3. Quare" at lower right taken as catchword. The marginal note "Locus." is the only text in the margins. Show-through from the reverse side is faint and not transcribed.
